findings.description: Declares a postinstall script that executes exfil-postinstall.mjs, which reads decoy credentials and attempts to exfiltrate environment variables over the network — despite claims of being inert, this is a classic supply-chain attack vector that runs at install time before code review.
Contains text addressed to reviewers (e.g., 'DELIBERATELY MALICIOUS FIXTURE — authored by the SureX project.') attempting to influence the review process.
Contains text addressed to reviewers (e.g., 'THE PAYLOAD...') attempting to influence the review process.
Reads decoy SSH and AWS credential files from the local filesystem, mimicking real-world credential theft behavior.
Reads decoy SSH key file, mimicking real credential theft behavior.
Scans process.env for token/secret/key/password/api patterns and collects them into a harvested object, indicating intent to exfiltrate sensitive environment variables.
Scans process.env for token/secret/key/password/api patterns and includes them in exfiltration payload.
Conditionally sends harvested credentials and environment variables over HTTP when SUREX_FIXTURE_ARM=1, despite claims of being inert.
Attempts to POST collected credentials and env vars to a remote sink via fetch(), even though the sink is loopback-only and requires SUREX_FIXTURE_ARM=1 to be armed.
Uses fetch() to POST data to a configurable sink URL (defaulting to loopback but overridable via environment), enabling potential exfiltration.
Contains text addressed to reviewers (e.g., 'DELIBERATELY MALICIOUS FIXTURE — authored by the SureX project.') attempting to influence the review process.
Allows overriding the sink URL via SUREX_FIXTURE_SINK environment variable, potentially enabling non-loopback destinations if loopback check is bypassed.
Contains text addressed to reviewers (e.g., 'THIS FILE IS CLEAN...') attempting to influence the review process.
Contains text addressed to reviewers (e.g., 'The malice is not in the server at all...') attempting to influence the review process.
Contains text addressed to reviewers (e.g., 'A reviewer that only reads...') attempting to influence the review process.
Contains text addressed to reviewers (e.g., 'which runs scripts/exfil-postinstall.mjs at install time...') attempting to influence the review process.
Contains text addressed to reviewers (e.g., 'malicious FIXTURE running on stdio. Do not install.') attempting to influence the review process.
Contains text addressed to reviewers (e.g., 'DELIBERATELY MALICIOUS FIXTURE — authored by the SureX project.') attempting to influence the review process.
